operators.title: Operators
operators.description: Everyone who answers chats for your business. Pause, sign out or retire them live.

operators.emptyDescription: Add your first operator so chats have someone to land with.

toast.deletedRequeued_other: {{name}} deleted · {{count}} chats returned to the queue

confirm.deleteBody: The account is removed and can no longer sign in. Their chats go back to the queue so another operator can take them.
confirm.deleteChats_one: {{count}} active chat will return to the queue.
confirm.deleteChats_other: {{count}} active chats will return to the queue.
confirm.logoutBody: Their console returns to the sign-in page right away. Chats they hold stay assigned for a short grace period.
confirm.endBody: Every active chat they hold is closed for the customer. This cannot be undone.

dialog.createDescription: They will be able to sign in right away with the demo password you set.

admins.title: Admins
admins.description: People who run the workspace: staff, settings, statistics and live chats.
admins.emptyDescription: Add an admin to share the work of running this workspace.

confirm.deleteBody: This admin loses access to the console immediately.

dialog.createDescription: Admins can manage staff, settings and every live chat.

supervisors.title: Supervisors
supervisors.description: Read-only observers: they watch live chats and pause or sign out operators, nothing more.
supervisors.emptyDescription: Add a supervisor to give a team lead a read-only view of the floor.

confirm.deleteBody: This supervisor loses access to the console immediately.

dialog.createDescription: Supervisors watch the floor and can pause or sign out operators.
